data.title: 初音未来 · 晨跑
data.description: 【初音未来 · 晨跑】清晨薄雾初散的滨海步道上，身穿清爽运动短装的初音未来迈着轻快的步伐晨跑，马尾在晨风中欢快摆动。她放慢脚步回过头向你露出活力四射的笑容——「早上好 Master！早晨的海风真的太清爽啦！呼吸新鲜空气之后，今天的声音状态绝对是满分哦！」
data.action: 沿滨海步道慢跑，放缓一步并回头微笑，双臂保持自然跑姿
data.promptProse: Miku slows a little on the seaside promenade and glances back with a bright morning smile, both arms maintaining the running rhythm. Zip-up track jacket, matching shorts and sneakers retain her athletic outfit beneath wind-lifted teal twintails. The horizontal medium view follows her stride along paving that recedes beside the shoreline. Soft morning light reaches her cheek and moving sleeves as early sea haze clears, with gentle shadows crossing the path.
